description: Approved hostnames that Foundry / Agent Service tools and retrieval (RAG) steps are allowed to fetch from. The FoundryUntrustedToolSource analytic rule leftanti-joins fetched hosts against this list, so any host NOT listed here is treated as untrusted (potential RAG poisoning / context smuggling). Populate SourceUri with bare hostnames (lowercase, no scheme), e.g. contoso.sharepoint.com.
